_comment: Verified working 2026-09-28. Bing News RSS is the backbone: it returns the REAL publisher url and name, so tiers actually resolve. Google News RSS is deliberately NOT used - it only returns news.google.com redirect urls, which is what killed the old sweeper.

bing._note: One query per aisle. This is how the taxonomy does real work: each aisle is swept on its own terms instead of hoping one keyword finds everything. It is also the only way CROSSOVER ever gets covered.

q.creator: streamer creator fans emotional attachment
q.character: TV series finale fans grief character fandom
q.companion: AI companion app Replika Character.AI users attachment
q.world: sports team fans emotional attachment community
q.brand: brand loyalty program fans obsession customers
q.contest: fandom backlash pile on creator online
q.grief: celebrity death fans grief mourning public
q.danger: sasaeng stalking idol fan arrested doxxing

reddit._note: Reddit blocks datacenter IPs, which is what GitHub Actions runs on - a plain request gets 403, and the .rss endpoint returns an identical ~321KB anti-bot page for every subreddit. Needs a free OAuth app. Set REDDIT_CLIENT_ID + REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET as repo secrets to switch these on. Until then they are off and the aisles lean on the Bing queries.
reddit._howto: https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps -> create app (script) -> put the id in REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and the secret in REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET

hn._note: Optional. Hacker News via Algolia, no key needed. Good for the AI-companion aisle where the discourse is oldest.

rejected_reasons: is about the product, not the feeling
